answers.how: The boat spans about 256 px at 2 s, or 253 px at 1 s after depth correction. Its bow moves about 99 px/s near 1 s, giving 99 × 10 / 253 ≈ 3.9 m/s.
At 2 s, the boat measures about 259 px from hull bottom to mast tip and 256 px in length. Its height is 10 × 259 / 256 ≈ 10.1 m.
